definitions.explanation: An injury caused by a blunt impact that damages tissue under the skin without breaking it, resulting in swelling and discoloration. A somewhat formal, medical term; the everyday word is {青|あお}{痣|あざ}.

examples.english: I suffered a bruise on my leg.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打撲傷|だぼくしょう}ができた。
examples.english: I fell and got a bruise on my knee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{単|たん}なる→単なる：01757_tannaru⟧{打撲傷|だぼくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧はないと⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor said it was just a bruise and there was nothing wrong with the bone.

notes:
{打撲傷|だぼくしょう} is the medical/formal term for a bruise, from ⟦{打撲|だぼく}→打撲：05017_daboku⟧ (blunt-force impact) + {傷|しょう} (injury).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {打撲傷|だぼくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to suffer a bruise
- {打撲傷|だぼくしょう}ができる: a bruise forms
- {軽|けい}い{打撲傷|だぼくしょう}: a minor bruise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧{痣|あざ}: bruise — the everyday word for the visible discoloration itself, used in casual speech rather than medical contexts
- ⟦{打撲|だぼく}→打撲：05017_daboku⟧: bruising, blunt trauma (the injury/impact in general, as a diagnosis, e.g. ⟦{打撲|だぼく}→打撲：05017_daboku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通院|つういん}→通院：05975_tsuuin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧)
